purpose: Recover similar issues by matching the observed defect separately from long full-ticket text
defect_branch_retriever: BM25 with existing tokenizer, no accent folding, top 100 positive-score matches
fusion: RRF k=60 over the complete baseline ranking (weight 1.0) and defect BM25 ranking (weight 0.5)
weight_rationale: Treat defect-only evidence as a supporting branch while preserving the deployed hybrid as the primary system; one fixed value analogous to a half-strength auxiliary source
no_tuning: No weight, k, field, or top-N sweep on these labels
evaluation: 40 AI-reviewed development queries; grade 1/2 relevant; unknown corpus items are not negatives
go_no_go: Known macro R@10 improves, R@100 does not fall, no component loses R@10, judged-pool nDCG does not decrease, and known grade-0 exposure@10 does not increase
deployment: Passing is a research signal only; failing leaves production unchanged
